title: EP 29 — THINK HARDER
lines: Extended thinking is on by default
Extended thinking is on by default. Clawd reasons before it acts.
Dial it with --effort: low to max
Dial it with the effort flag. Low, medium, high, x-high, max. Default is high.
Pass dash dash effort high to a headless run. Deeper reasoning, one session, no persist.
One-off boost? Put ultrathink in the prompt
Want a one-off boost? Drop ultrathink into the prompt itself. It adds an in-context nudge.
"think hard" is just text now — not a keyword
Heads up. Think, think hard, think more are plain text now. Only ultrathink is recognized.
Follow for a daily Claude Code tip
Follow for a fresh Clawd Code tip every day.
command: claude --effort high -p "ultrathink: fix the unicode edge case in slugify"
